name: כפל שני שברים – צמצום גורמים משותפים (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Simplify the following expression by removing common factors in the numerator and denominator.

\({{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}} = \) [[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]

Be sure to leave your answer in its simplest form.
generalfeedback:
Outline: Multiply the numerators together and the denominators together, then remove the common factors.
Step 1 — Multiply the numerators and the denominators
Simply multiply the numerators and denominators together respectively:

\[ \frac{a}{b}\cdot\frac{c}{d} = \frac{a \cdot c}{b \cdot d} \]

Therefore in this example:

\[ {{CT:0}}\cdot{{CT:1}} = \frac{{{CT:2}}\cdot{{CT:3}}}{{{CT:4}}\cdot{{CT:5}}} = \frac{{{CT:6}}}{{{CT:7}}} \]

Step 2 — Simplify to lowest terms
[[if test="{{CT:10}}"]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:6}}\) and \({{CT:7}}\) is \({{CT:8}}\). Divide the numerator and denominator by \({{CT:8}}\):

\[ \frac{{{CT:6}}}{{{CT:7}}}=\frac{{{CT:6}}\div {{CT:8}}}{{{CT:7}}\div {{CT:8}}}={{CT:9}} \]

[[else]]The greatest common divisor of \({{CT:6}}\) and \({{CT:7}}\) is \(1\), so nothing cancels. [[/if]]The numerator and the denominator now have no common factor (their greatest common divisor is \(1\)), so the answer is in lowest terms:

\[ {{CT:9}} \]
